<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the `carbon_nmr_spectra` tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges with `retrieve_carbon_shifts` to identify the aromatic region (generally ~110–160 ppm). By counting the distinct carbon signals that fall within this aromatic range, I can infer the number of aromatic carbons in the compound.</thought>
